text:
Sam R: Heads-up team — AuroraCloud's marketplace PO (AC-PO-2026-1102) is blocked by procurement. They're pushing PO-only terms, removing our standard IP carveouts, and requesting Net-90 payment. Need a quick call.

Lina K: Saw it. Their procurement redlined our IP/outputs clause and added broad audit/data residency obligations. Legal can't accept PO-only that rewrites IP.

Priya V: AuroraCloud insisted on PO-only to meet their vendor onboarding. Marketing has a joint webinar scheduled Mon, so timing's tight.

Ethan M: Finance note: Net-90 is non-starter for us on a new partner; can offer Net-30 if we get card/ACH or a credit check. Also need invoice milestones to wire up AR.

Lina K: Proposal: accept a signed conditional PO that references our short-form addendum (2 pages) preserving platform IP + limited output license, plus a 15% payment holdback until the addendum is executed. Pilot liability cap = fees paid in 12 months.

Sam R: That could work. Priya, can you confirm ARR so finance can size exposure?

Priya V: Confirmed ARR = $360,000 year one. Aurora says procurement can sign a conditional PO with explicit holdback language.

Ethan M: With that ARR, finance will accept the 12-month fee cap and Net-30. Need invoice schedule.

Priya V: Milestones proposed: 2026-05-04 marketplace tile live = 50%, 2026-06-04 integration completion = 30%, 2026-07-04 final acceptance = 20%. Sending signed schedule to Ethan and attaching to the PO.

ProcureBot: PO AC-PO-2026-1102 status changed to "Review Requested" by Lina K at 2026-05-02 16:08 UTC.

Lina K: I'll post the 2-page addendum in the deal folder now. It keeps core IP protections, sets 12-month liability cap, and specifies 15% holdback release when addendum fully executed and acceptance tests pass.

Sam R: Great. I'll ask Aurora procurement for conditional PO that references the addendum and the holdback. If they push for PO-only without reference, escalate to VP Partnerships.

Priya V: Aurora procurement contact said they'd route a conditional PO internally if legal-to-legal confirms the addendum text. I'll loop them in.

Ethan M: Once we have conditional PO + invoice schedule, AR will provision Net-30 terms. Otherwise we can't accept Net-90.

Lina K: Draft uploaded. TL;DR in thread: preserve platform IP, limited license for listing, 12-month fee cap, 15% holdback during pilot. If Aurora refuses, escalate to VP Legal.

Sam R: Thanks. Goal: conditional PO received + signed addendum by 2026-05-02 EOD to keep the webinar timeline. If not, escalate to Partnerships lead and Sales Ops.

ProcureBot: Outstanding items: conditional PO referencing addendum, signed addendum, invoice schedule. Due by 2026-05-02 23:59 UTC.
